data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 冬季街头
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 冬季街头】冬日黄昏的寒风穿过街道，雪乃将格子围巾向上拉住，遮好口鼻。她穿着海军蓝牛角扣大衣，侧头望向落后半步的同行者，蓝色眼眸里透出克制的关切。路灯已亮，细雪落在围巾边缘。
data.action: 一手拉住格子围巾遮好口鼻，另一手放大衣口袋，侧头关切地看同行者
data.camera: cowboy shot, wrapping scarf in falling snow
data.promptProse: Yukino lifts her plaid scarf over her mouth and nose, her other hand tucked into her coat pocket. She turns a concerned glance toward the viewer as small snowflakes gather in the warm streetlight.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the scarf over her face while the other stays in her pocket.
